title: Kestrel and the Spire
author: Ines Oyelaran
blurb: Jonah Crane, a cartographer of unmapped realms, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
